description: Curated Typst package recipes for documents and presentations. Each directory contains a focused README.md and a compile-verified demo.typ.

packages.name: numbly
packages.description: Heading numbering format helper — specify different numbering formats for different heading levels with a simple syntax.
packages.best_for: Custom heading numbering (e.g., 'Appendix A.', 'A.1.', 'Step 1.')

packages.name: glossarium
packages.description: Glossary and acronym system with first-use expansion, plurals, grouping, filtering, and back-references.
packages.best_for: Maintained glossaries and acronym lists in papers, theses, reports, manuals, and books

packages.name: theorion
packages.description: Out-of-the-box, customizable and multilingual theorem environment package. Supports theorem, definition, lemma, corollary, example, proof, and more.
packages.best_for: Mathematical presentations with theorem/proof environments

packages.name: sanity
packages.description: Manuscript preflight for unreferenced labelled elements, uncited bibliography entries, lost labels, caption issues, and reference order.
packages.best_for: Structural citation and cross-reference checks after ordinary Typst validation

packages.name: charged-ieee
packages.description: Maintained two-column IEEE-style paper template with numeric citations, semantic figures, equations, and bibliography support.
packages.best_for: IEEE-style engineering or computer-science papers when the venue's current author instructions match the template

packages.name: lovelace
packages.description: Pseudocode typesetting package — write pseudocode with arbitrary keywords, optional line numbering, and line labels.
packages.best_for: Algorithm presentations, pseudocode display

packages.name: mitex
packages.description: LaTeX math support for Typst — convert LaTeX equations to Typst via WASM. Supports inline (#mi), block (#mitex/#mimath), and text mode (#mitext).
packages.best_for: Converting LaTeX equations to Typst, reusing existing LaTeX formulas

packages.name: pinit
packages.description: Relative positioning by pins — pin content to specific positions, highlight text, add annotations. Works with Touying animations.
packages.best_for: Equation annotations, text highlighting, pointer arrows on slides

packages.name: codly
packages.description: Beautiful and powerful code blocks with line numbers, icons, annotations, and skip/range display. Highly customizable.
packages.best_for: Professional code display with line numbers and annotations

packages.name: zebraw
packages.description: Lightweight code blocks with line numbers, line highlighting, comments, and zebra-striped emphasis.
packages.best_for: Lightweight code listings with selective line highlighting

packages.name: cheq
packages.description: Markdown-like checklist syntax — supports [x], [ ], [/], [-] and custom symbols. GitHub Flavored Markdown compatible.
packages.best_for: Checklists, task lists, to-do items on slides

packages.name: examora
packages.description: Chinese examination-paper document class with score tables, question sections, answer-space controls, deterministic randomization, and learner or answer editions.
packages.best_for: Chinese school or university exams that need explicit candidate fields, binding-aware page geometry, and shared question/answer source

packages.name: ezexam
packages.description: Chinese exam and handout layout with sealing lines, A4 or imposed A3 paper modes, semantic questions, answer markers, and solution blocks.
packages.best_for: Chinese exams or handouts whose print conventions need sealing lines, localized numbering, and same-source learner and solution editions

packages.name: lilaq
packages.description: Mature Typst-native plotting library with publication-ready line, bar, scatter, distribution, contour, and vector-field plots. Default for the existing SeaSlides statistical chart templates.
packages.best_for: Standard slide charts, publication-ready scientific plots, and direct control over axes and marks

packages.name: gribouille
packages.description: Declarative Grammar of Graphics library inspired by ggplot2 and plotnine, with mapped aesthetics, layers, statistical transforms, scales, labels, and themes. The API is still actively evolving.
packages.best_for: Layered analytical plots, data-driven aesthetic mappings, statistical summaries, and grammar-of-graphics workflows

packages.name: cetz
packages.description: Typst-native canvas and drawing primitives for custom geometry, annotations, and scientific illustrations.
packages.best_for: Editable custom drawings whose geometry needs direct coordinate and path control

packages.name: merman
packages.description: Compile Mermaid source to export-safe SVG directly in Typst through the headless Rust renderer and bundled WebAssembly plugin.
packages.best_for: Mermaid flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, state diagrams, and other declarative diagrams

packages.name: fletcher
packages.description: Typst-native node-and-edge diagrams with graph layouts, routable arrows, labels, shapes, groups, and mathematical grids.
packages.best_for: Editable flowcharts, state machines, graphs, trees, architecture sketches, and commutative diagrams

packages.name: chronos
packages.description: Typst-native sequence diagrams with participants, messages, lifelines, activation, creation, groups, notes, and separators.
packages.best_for: Editable interaction and protocol sequence diagrams whose message order and lifelines matter

packages.name: tablem
packages.description: Markdown-like table syntax — copy-paste markdown tables directly into Typst. Includes three-line-table preset.
packages.best_for: Quick tables from markdown syntax, academic three-line tables

packages.name: tiaoma
packages.description: Barcode and QR code generator — supports nearly all common barcode types via zint WASM. Includes QR Code, EAN, Code 128, Data Matrix, etc.
packages.best_for: QR codes and barcodes in documents, labels, forms, posters, handouts, and slides

packages.name: cuti
packages.description: Fake bold / fake italic / fake small capitals simulation — especially useful for CJK fonts (e.g., SimSun) that lack bold weight.
packages.best_for: Chinese documents or presentations using an available CJK font without a bold or italic face

packages.name: shadowed
packages.description: CSS-like box shadows for Typst blocks — drop shadows with blur, spread, offset, and corner radius support
packages.best_for: Card shadows, elevated components, paper-craft style effects

packages.name: scoryst
packages.description: Music engraving through a Typst WebAssembly plugin backed by Verovio. Renders ABC, MusicXML, MEI, Humdrum, EsAC, PAE, Volpiano, and CMME to SVG.
packages.best_for: Creating or embedding symbolic staff notation while keeping ABC, MusicXML, MEI, or another supported source editable

packages.name: unify
packages.description: Formats supplied numbers, uncertainties, quantities, units, and ranges with a string-based scientific-notation grammar.
packages.best_for: Source-faithful scientific measurements, uncertainty, unit expressions, and numeric or quantity ranges

packages.name: typsium
packages.description: Typesets supplied chemical formulas, reactions, isotopes, charges, phases, arrows, and reaction annotations.
packages.best_for: Semantic chemical notation and reaction display without hand-built subscripts or arrows

packages.name: typed-smiles
packages.description: Renders supplied SMILES as 2D molecular structures with a Rust/WASM parser and CeTZ drawing layer.
packages.best_for: Editable-source skeletal molecular structures in chemistry notes, papers, reports, and teaching material

packages.name: quill
packages.description: Renders quantum circuits through a manual grid or the composable Tequila instruction model.
packages.best_for: Source-controlled quantum circuit figures with semantic gates and wires

packages.name: zap
packages.description: Draws source-controlled electronic circuits with standards-inspired components and explicit connectivity.
packages.best_for: Editable electronic schematics with resistors, capacitors, semiconductors, logic, instruments, and integrated devices

packages.name: eggs
packages.description: Typesets numbered linguistic examples, interlinear glosses, judgments, references, and abbreviation lists.
packages.best_for: Semantic linguistic examples and Leipzig-style interlinear glossed text

packages.name: synkit
packages.description: Renders supplied bracket notation as linguistic syntax trees with optional movement and annotation features.
packages.best_for: Editable phrase-structure trees whose constituent analysis and labels are already supplied

packages.name: typed-scores
packages.description: Engraves Western staff notation from compact note text using a Rust/WASM parser, CeTZ, and bundled Bravura glyphs.
packages.best_for: Author-controlled Western scores whose canonical source is compact note-and-duration text

packages.name: fretwork
packages.description: Typesets source-controlled guitar, bass, ukulele, and custom-tuning tablature with rhythm, techniques, repeats, lyrics, and ASCII-tab import.
packages.best_for: Publication-quality tablature whose canonical source records strings, frets, timing, and playing techniques

packages.name: physica
packages.description: Provides semantic math helpers for vectors, operators, derivatives, matrices, Dirac notation, tensors, isotopes, and related scientific notation.
packages.best_for: Scientific and engineering formulas that need consistent source-controlled notation instead of manually assembled symbols
